q: يَا مُحَمَّدُ، ___ بَابَ الْغُرْفَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
e: Muhammad, open the door of the room, please.
Ahmad, sit here next to me.
Ali, drink a lot of water.
Yusuf, write a letter to your grandfather.
Khalid, look out of the window.

q: يَا سَمِيرُ، ___ مُبَكِّرًا، فَعِنْدَكَ امْتِحَانٌ غَدًا.
e: Samir, go to bed early, because you have an exam tomorrow.
Omar, eat this apple.
Son, get out of bed, you are late.

q: يَا كَرِيمُ، ___ مَعَ أَخِيكَ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ.
e: Karim, play with your brother in the garden.

q: يَا طَارِقُ، ___ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، الْأُسْتَاذُ يَتَكَلَّمُ.
e: Tariq, listen please, the teacher is speaking.

q: يَا أَبِي، ___ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ مُبَكِّرًا الْيَوْمَ.
e: Dad, come back home early today.
Hasan, wash your hands before eating.
Ziyad, put on your coat, it is cold.

q: يَا مَازِنُ، ___ مُعَلِّمَكَ إِذَا لَمْ تَفْهَمْ.
e: Mazin, ask your teacher if you don't understand.
Rami, start with the first question.
Grandad, walk slowly, the path is difficult.
Muhammad, tell us what happened.

q: يَا وَلِيدُ، ___ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ قَبْلَ الِامْتِحَانِ.
e: Walid, read this book before the exam.
Sara, open the window, please.
Layla, sit on this chair.
Mum, sleep a little, you are tired.
Fatima, read the lesson again.
Hind, wash the plates after dinner.

q: يَا مَرْيَمُ، ___ إِلَى الصُّورَةِ، مَا أَجْمَلَهَا!
e: Maryam, look at the picture, how beautiful it is!
Salma, tell your father that you are tired.
My girl, drink all the milk.
Reem, go to the market with us.
Huda, wear the blue dress.
Grandma, eat some of this food.
Nadia, write your name on the paper.
Dina, ask the seller about the price.
Muna, take the medicine after eating.
Zaynab, listen to your mother.

q: يَا أُخْتِي، ___ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ، الْجَوُّ جَمِيلٌ.
e: Go outside, sister, the weather is lovely.
Layla, take the bus to the university.
Children, open the door, please.
Students, sit in your places.
Children, eat all of this food.
Guys, drink water before the match.
Students, write the sentence in your notebooks.
My friends, look at this picture.
Children, sleep now, it is late.
Students, read the story at home.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، ___ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ وَلَا تَتَأَخَّرُوا.
e: Children, play in the garden and don't be late.
Guys, come in quickly, the film has started.

q: يَا طُلَّابُ، ___ الْمُعَلِّمَ إِذَا لَمْ تَفْهَمُوا.
e: Students, ask the teacher if you don't understand.
Children, wash your hands before eating.
My friends, go to the sea with us.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، ___ مِنَ السَّرِيرِ، جَاءَ الصَّبَاحُ.
e: Children, get out of bed, morning has come.
Students, take the books from the library.

q: يَا شَبَابُ، ___ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ قَبْلَ اللَّيْلِ.
e: Guys, come back home before dark.
Children, speak Arabic with your mother.
Ahmad, help your little brother.
Muhammad, wait here until I come back.
Ali, call your mother, she is worried.
Samir, close the car door.
Yusuf, think before you answer.

q: يَا خَالِدُ، ___ هَذِهِ الْحَقِيبَةَ إِلَى السَّيَّارَةِ.
e: Khalid, carry this bag to the car.
Omar, thank your teacher for his help.
Son, put your key in the bag.
Hasan, answer the teacher's question.

q: يَا طَارِقُ، ___ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، لَا تَيْأَسْ.
e: Tariq, try again, don't give up.
Grandad, go up the stairs slowly.
Sara, help your mother in the kitchen.
Layla, wait here for five minutes.
Maryam, sing us a beautiful song.
Huda, draw a picture of your house.
Fatima, send the letter to the manager.

q: يَا رِيمُ، ___ مُبَكِّرًا غَدًا، عِنْدَنَا رِحْلَةٌ.
e: Reem, wake up early tomorrow, we have a trip.
Mum, listen to this song.

q: يَا سَلْمَى، ___ هَذَا الْفِيلْمَ، هُوَ رَائِعٌ.
e: Salma, watch this film, it is wonderful.
Zaynab, invite your friends to the party.
Dina, cut the bread with this knife.
My girl, remember the doctor's appointment.
Children, carry the chairs to the room.
Students, learn the new words.
Guys, wait here a little.
My friends, dance with us at the party.
Children, thank your father for the presents.
Students, use the dictionary in the exam.
Guys, go up to the second floor.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، ___ عَنْ قِطَّتِكُمْ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ.
e: Children, look for your cat in the garden.
Students, answer the third question.
My friends, leave the place before dark.

q: يَا أَوْلَادُ، ___ فِي الْبَحْرِ قُرْبَ الشَّاطِئِ.
e: Children, swim in the sea near the shore.
Girls, help your mother at home.
Students, answer the questions quickly.

q: يَا بَنَاتُ، ___ هُنَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ الْأُسْتَاذُ.
e: Girls, wait here until the teacher comes.

q: يَا سَيِّدَاتُ، ___ إِلَى الْحَافِلَةِ مِنْ هُنَا.
e: Ladies, get on the bus here.
Girls, sing a song for the Eid.
Students, write your names on the paper.
Ahmad and Samir, sit here.

q: يَا سَارَةُ وَيَا لَيْلَى، ___ أَخَاكُمَا الصَّغِيرَ.
e: Sara and Layla, help your little brother.
My two friends, explain to me what happened.
Ali, stand here and don't move.
Son, learn your lessons by heart every day.
Muhammad, repair my watch, please.
Salma, choose the dress you like.
Huda, fill the glass with water.

q: يَا أُمِّي، ___ لِي بِالْخُرُوجِ مَعَ صَدِيقَاتِي.
e: Mum, let me go out with my friends.
Guys, take part in the competition.
My friends, celebrate the success with me.
Students, collect the papers from the tables.

q: يَا بَنَاتُ، ___ الْكُتُبَ إِلَى الْغُرْفَةِ الْأُخْرَى.
e: Girls, move the books to the other room.
Children, take care of your health.
